summary: Master Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service with our comprehensive training. Equip yourself with the tools to improve customer interactions and support.
lede: Customer service training for Dynamics 365 helps agents, team leads, CRM administrators, and service managers improve case handling and service workflows. Participants practise configuring case intake, queues and routing, service-level agreement timers and escalations, while using knowledge articles and communication records to support consistent resolutions. They also learn to review service data and access, interpret dashboards and performance trends, and plan improvements for backlogs, surges, and recurring issues.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across various roles and responsibilities, seeking to enhance their expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service.
audience: Customer service officers, agents, and team leads
Contact center supervisors and operations managers
Customer experience (CX) and service quality teams
CRM administrators and Dynamics 365 functional consultants
IT/Helpdesk teams using Dynamics for internal service
modules: Foundations of Dynamics 365 Customer Service Operations
SLA Design and Enforcement in Dynamics 365
Knowledge Management for Faster, Consistent Resolutions
Omnichannel Service and Digital Engagement Workflows
Data Quality, Security, and Auditability in Service Records
Dashboards, Reports, and Service Performance Interpretation
Escalations, Incidents, and High-Pressure Case Surges
Automation and Productivity Tools in Customer Service
Implementation Readiness and Continuous Improvement Plan
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of customer service processes and familiarity with CRM systems. Prior experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is beneficial but not required.
